purpose: Additive simulation reserve mapping for commercial resource sites not covered by the 250-row base reserve dataset. Existing source reserve records take precedence.
notes: These are simulation-only game quantities, not verified geological reserves or current real-world production.
The supplement retains existing simulated site quantities where available and supplies deterministic 400-game-year fallback values only when missing.
Runtime normalization retains source quantity and unit in quantityNormalization metadata.
The runtime only inserts a supplement record when a higher-priority base reserve record is absent.
